## Summary
A concise description of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Related Issues
- Resolves #(issue_number)

## Changes Made
- Component / Module: Description of change

## Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass locally (`HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"`).
- [ ] New functionality includes dedicated unit tests in `tests/`.
- [ ] No credentials, API keys, private tokens, or sensitive personal data are included.
- [ ] No database files (`.db`, `.sqlite`) or runtime logs (`logs/`) are tracked.
- [ ] No emojis were added in code, logs, comments, or UI templates.
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) updated if applicable.
